newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Four missing after Australia coal mine flood.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Four missing after Australia coal mine flood.

text.p: A flooding at Oakbridge Ltd's Gretley colliery in the Hunter Valley of New South Wales has left four miners missing 120 metres underground, Newcastle police said.
Two rescue crews were working underground to locate the missing men, they said.

Oakbridge officials would not comment when contacted by Reuters but police said rescue crews were searching the underground mine near Newcastle after water rushed into an area the miners were working.
The accident occurred about 5.30 a.m. (1830 GMT).
Four miners were washed out of the area by the water, but the other four remain unaccounted for, police said.
